# MAB AI Strategies

> MAB AI Strategies LLC is an AI automation consultancy founded by Mark Bockrath. It builds custom AI agents, workflow automation and AI sales systems around the tools a business already runs, for companies of up to about 1,000 employees in any industry.

## Services
- [Services and pricing](https://www.mabaistrategies.com/services): AI Readiness Audit ($2,000), Junior Dev Retainer ($1,000 a month, 6-month minimum), Google Special ($800 a month, 8-month minimum), Senior Dev Retainer (system build $5,000 to $25,000, then $500 or $1,000 a month), departmental discovery ($500 per department), executive training ($1,000 per 5 seats), team coaching ($120 per seat per session).
- [Systems we build](https://www.mabaistrategies.com/command): representative agent, workflow, skill and web app patterns.

## Company
- [About](https://www.mabaistrategies.com/about): founder background and how an engagement runs.
